snippet.title: Cat Me If You Can - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
Can you bring color back to a world full of hidden cats?

Cat Me If You Can is a cozy exploration game where you travel through black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats and restoring their colors through photography.

Slow down, look closely, and uncover charming secrets in beautifully handcrafted environments.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170490/Cat_Me_If_You_Can/

🐾 About the Game

📸 A Cozy Cat Hunt
• Explore stylized black-and-white worlds
• Find hidden cats and capture them with your camera

🧩 Clever Puzzles
• Solve riddles and unlock hidden paths
• Discover cats hidden behind secrets and mechanisms

🌍 Beautiful Locations
• Travel across diverse themed environments
• From ancient ruins to modern cities and castles

👀 Observation is Key
• Some cats are easy to find, others are well hidden
• Pay attention to details and think creatively

💫 A Relaxing Experience
• Calm and atmospheric gameplay
• Designed for exploration and discovery at your own pace
